definitions.gloss: latent strength; hidden reserves of power
definitions.explanation: Strength that is not visible in ordinary circumstances but emerges under pressure. Used of individuals, teams, companies, and economies alike, always with admiration.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{底|そこ}{力|ぢから}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: The team showed its true strength.

examples.japanese: ⟦{追|お}い{込|こ}まれて→追い込む：06371_oikomu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{底|そこ}{力|ぢから}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}した→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧。
examples.english: It was only once cornered that they showed their hidden strength.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不況|ふきょう}→不況：04844_fukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{雇用|こよう}→雇用：04840_koyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}り→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{底|そこ}{力|ぢから}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The company's underlying strength shows in the fact that it kept protecting jobs even through the recession.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
The second element is voiced to ぢ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧, not ちから — one of the few common words that keeps the ぢ spelling in modern orthography.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {底|そこ}{力|ぢから}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧: to display one's latent strength
- {底|そこ}{力|ぢから}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧: to show what one is really made of
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{底|そこ}{力|ぢから}: the underlying strength of the Japanese economy

USAGE:
The word implies adversity: it is used when strength appears in a pinch, so it fits comebacks, late rallies, and recoveries rather than steady everyday performance.
